messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: High error rate on model-warmup jobs in us-west-2 (cluster: inference-prod-usw2). Error: cudaMalloc OOM during deserialization. PagerDuty: https://p.example/pd/INC12345
samantha: ack — i'm oncall, investigating. assigning eng-oncall
eng-oncall: saw spikes in kernel OOM and container restarts on nodes gpu-node-12..15. Logs show repeated `cudaErrorMemoryAllocation` and `bad_alloc` during model deserialization
alex: looks like KV cache eviction + artifact load -> paging thrash. root cause likely warmup concurrency + large unquantized artifacts. any immediate mitigation suggestions?
samantha: mitigation1: reduce warmup concurrency to 1 for that pool. patching autoscaler: `service.warmup.concurrency: 1` now
mike: routing mitigation: switch prod route to q4f16 variant as fallback. will canary 5% traffic to q4 to reduce mem pressure
julia: CS flagged ticket #7892 — customers hitting 502/503 on realtime endpoints. impact: a few mid-market customers in us-west-2. CS on standby for comms
eng-oncall: deployed concurrency patch, saw peak concurrent warmups drop. nodes still flapping due to residual paging thrash. next: drain gpu-node-14 and reprovision
alex: running `kubectl drain gpu-node-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` now; evicting pods from node-14
incidents-bot: Update: automated rampdown of batch size for affected family from 32 -> 8 scheduled (will apply in 30s)
samantha: temporarily disabling model precompile to avoid compile timeout spikes: `model.serve.precompile=false` — applied to warmup pool
mike: also toggled routing policy: `if paging_score > 0.6 -> prefer model_variant=q4f16` to bias away from full-precision loads
julia: :thumbsup: CS posted draft comm in #customer-success-drafts, will ping once we have stable metrics. estimated ETA for stable state ~2h
alex: confirming metrics: OOM-related restarts reduced after drain + concurrency patch. 5xxs for /v1/generate down from ~7% -> ~0.8% over last 10m
samantha: keeping incident open for monitoring. actions: postmortem, tune warmup rate limiter, increase eviction thresholds for large artifacts, consider pre-warm using quantized artifacts only
mike: creating PD incident and follow-up task for eng-runtime to investigate deserialization memory high-water mark and compiler parallelism defaults
eng-oncall: handoff to eng-sre (mike) at 1775554623 — leaving for follow-up work. continuing watch on metrics
pagerduty-bot: Incident INC12345 acknowledged by samantha. Severity set to Sev2.
incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigations in place, customer impact significantly reduced, no evidence of data loss. Keeping page open for observation and root-cause work.
